resources.title: Marcus Aurelius
resources.creator: Rachana Kamtekar · Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy
resources.relevance: Explains the notebook’s form and examines difficult questions about Stoic ethics. Useful when a compact reminder needs a fuller argument.
resources.spoilerNote: Discusses and quotes passages from across all twelve books. Optional background; it can wait until after a first reading.

resources.title: Marcus Aurelius (121–180 C.E.)
resources.creator: John Sellars · Internet Encyclopedia of Philosophy
resources.relevance: Introduces philosophical exercises and the influence of Epictetus, with a concise guide to the relevant ideas.
resources.spoilerNote: Uses examples from later books and offers an interpretation of the work as a whole. Optional further reading.
